'''Tim Collins''' of Wichita, Kansas, was the first of 1,074 correct entries for Puzzle 2 of the 1997 Dagobah Contest, [[Found Someone You Have]]. He won a display box of white-border Premiere packs.<ref name="sol2">[http://rothko.decipher.com/new/dagobahcontest/solution2.html The Dagobah Contest], Decipher (March 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970327214350/http://rothko.decipher.com/new/dagobahcontest/solution2.html Internet Archive]</ref>
